name: Happy Harvest
author: Unity Play
description:
Happy Harvest is an enchanting 2D top-down farming simulation game that invites you to cultivate, craft, and create your perfect farm. Built using a Unity sample project and powered by the cutting-edge capabilities of WebGPU, Happy Harvest offers smooth performance and stunning visual fidelity directly in your browser. From planting and nurturing crops to selling them at the market, your green-thumbed adventures await in this delightful and immersive farming experience. 
Ready to harvest happiness? Dive into Happy Harvest today!

Get the Happy Harvest - 2D Sample Project for free on the Unity AssetStore: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/essentials/tutorial-projects/happy-harvest-2d-sample-project-259218
